why: The 2026-09-03 batch compared the elpd difference against se_elpd_loo, the SE of ONE model's total. That quantity is dominated by variation ACROSS observations, which is common to both models and cancels in the difference; the model-comparison statistic is sd(d) * sqrt(n) on the paired per-observation differences (Vehtari, Gelman & Gabry 2017, Stat Comput 27:1413-1432, sec 3.3). why: pit_block() and calib() computed the catch stream's PIT, coverage and p_zero from a plain NB2 while the fit was a mixture, so theta_C was excluded from the model's own zero probability. Under the mixture P(Y=0) = theta + (1-theta)*NB2(0). elpd was never affected: Stan's log_lik carried the mixture from the start. NOTE the approximation: this uses E[theta]*E[p0] in place of E[theta*p0] because the committed files hold only the marginal means. Stage Z2 renders the exact value.
